name: Line interior
blurb: Thin indigo line, white fills, sparse accents
mechanism: One thin uniform indigo outline (1.4 px) around white-filled shapes in a wide, airy room, with flat colour on under 7% of the card.

line: Indigo #3a2d66 stroke 1.4 round caps and joins on every filled shape; details 1 (folds, veins, brows), finger lines 0.9; background decor #cfc9e0 at 1, unfilled.
rules: Fill shapes white; colour covers under 7% of the card.
One outline weight: 1.4 indigo, details 1, no shading.
Background decor in pale lavender line only: bricks, lamps, posters.
Floor line at y 308 with short dashes at both ends.
Slim realistic people, head about one seventh of height, calm faces.
The figure acts out the subject; plants and props frame it.
